Tax Code — Transactions

This screen displays all transactions that have been recorded using a specific tax code.

Use this report to review where and how a particular tax code has been applied throughout your accounting records.

The list includes transactions from various sources such as sales invoices, purchase invoices, receipts, payments, and journal entries.

This comprehensive view helps ensure your tax code usage is consistent and assists with tax compliance and reporting.

For more information, see: Tax Code — Edit
